headline: GTA VI developer hides a memorial to his late mother inside the game
label: VIRAL
caption:
A GTA VI developer has hidden a permanent tribute to his late mother inside the game 🕊️

Rockstar Games QA developer Matt Green shared on Instagram that his mother, Beverly Green, is now honoured on a memorial wall just north of Hamlet in the game's state of Leonida, as reported by Dexerto and The Express Tribune.

She passed away on March 30, 2026, almost eight months before GTA VI launched on November 19, so she never got to see the finished game. Green said her choice to buy him an old GTA game as a kid is what set him on the path to Rockstar.

Players have since found other names on the same wall, including the father and daughter of production designer Terrance Radcliff, both lost during development.
